browse.instructions: OpenCode Browse: the user's real signed-in browser via the paired Chromium extension. Use for Gmail, certificates, portals, and any task that needs an existing login or 2FA. Create a named session and restrict allowedOrigins to the sites the task needs. Hand logins/2FA/payments back to the user and wait for Continue. Never paste passwords or one-time codes into tool arguments.

agent-desktop.instructions: Vercel Labs agent-desktop: native Windows UI Automation. Snapshot first, act on refs (@snapshot:ref), re-snapshot to verify. Refs are snapshot-scoped; STALE_REF or AMBIGUOUS_TARGET means take a new snapshot. Prefer ref actions over pixel input. Clipboard, traces, notifications, pixel mouse and key/mouse down/up are deliberately not enabled.
